notes.title: Bigger, Better Bang for Buck
notes.content:
[b]Stereo Aereo[/b] is back, and [b]fully improved[/b].

We’ve been working on a [b]big[/b] update for Stereo Aereo, and are happy to release it today, along the PS4 release of Stereo Aereo (The game is also available on XBOX one) :)

To celebrate this [b]epic milestone[/b] we’ve [b]lowered the price[/b] of Stereo Aereo [b]permanently[/b] from $6,99 to [b]$3,99[/b] and made the following improvements to the game:

[list][*] [b]Content:[/b] New levels, 9 and 10: Stereo Aereo will have to face their biggest musical challenge yet.
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] Patterns in all levels have been remastered, along with their songs.
[*] [b]Boss fights:[/b] Checkpoints have been added on boss battle stages.
[*] [b]Graphics:[/b] Cutscenes have gotten a mayor lift in animation and color.
[*] [b]Overall:[/b] Improved performance and graphics.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684431/dedffec52fa83df516f18d7df79f9db103106429.png[/img]

We hope you’ll enjoy the newly improved Stereo Aereo!

Cheers,



The StoneBot Studio

notes.title: Stereo Aereo OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Yes, it's here and it's awesome. Really... Just ask Rock ;)

To celebrate this great event, Stereo Aereo has a 10% launch discount for a [b]limited[/b] time only. Stereo Aereo won't be participating in the Steam Holiday Sale, so be sure to grab the discount while you can!

Let us also take this opportunity to thank the people from our team who have been working on Stereo Aereo. Our team is a combination of young Salvadorans, who are great artists and programmers, that have been working together on a lot of local projects throughout these years. Together we are working on what we love to do: videogames

We are thrilled to be doing what we love and we're always learning more about development, so that you as a player like our stuff. We hope you'll enjoy Stereo Aereo and our future games.

Best,

Stonebot Studio

notes.title: One More Day
notes.content:
We want to thank everyone who have been playtesting our game. We've received great feedback to help us improve the game before release tomorrow :) The game will automatically update tomorrow to its final version for you.

We are excited to bring Stereo Aereo to you tomorrow. Hope you guys will enjoy Stereo Aereo as much as we've enjoyed developing it. 

[b]FACT:[/b] Stereo Aereo has changed a lot since its first design: [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684431/036c4cdfe3ccf0cfb38dfed4aad1edc61864e99d.png[/img]

Cheers,

The Stonebot

notes.title: ROADIES... UHM... WE MEAN TESTERS WANTED!
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE 12/13/2016[/b]
The game will see its release tomorrow, therefore we aren't looking for roadies anymore, but who knows in the near future ;) thanks everyone!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684431/1d2d5a1c8c5a7cf677536d6fa30a3c7704021bf2.png[/img]We are wrapping up the development of #StereoAereo for its release and therefore we are looking for a couple of Steam testers! You'll get a free Steam copy of the game but you do have to provide us with the necessary feedback! If you are interested, just send an email to stereoaereo[at]indietopia[dot]org. Looking forward to hear from you! :)

Cheers,

The Stonebot Studio
